issues.description: Missing shebang '#!/usr/bin/env python3'. Code-style rule #1 requires conanfile.py to start with shebang + docstring. File begins directly with the module docstring without a shebang line.
issues.fix_suggestion: Add '#!/usr/bin/env python3' as the first line, before the module docstring.

issues.description: Template placeholder 'url = ""  # CI fills this' is explicitly prohibited by code-style rule #5. The rule states this pattern appearing in merged code means the recipe is 'not finished'. The url attribute should point to the recipe's repository.
issues.fix_suggestion: Set the recipe URL to the actual repository address (e.g., url = 'https://cnb.cool/your-org/your-repo') or remove the url attribute entirely if not needed.

issues.description: Missing shebang '#!/usr/bin/env python3'. Code-style rule #1 applies to all conanfile.py files including test_package. File starts with 'import os' without a shebang.
issues.fix_suggestion: Add '#!/usr/bin/env python3' as the first line before the import statements.

issues.description: Missing '-o pipefail' in set command. File has 'set -eu' but code-style rule #7 requires all scripts to start with 'set -euo pipefail' for full safe mode.

Non-standard output markers. Uses '[test]' instead of '[step]', and emoji markers (✅/❌) instead of '[ok]'/'[fail]'. Code-style rule #9 requires standardized markers: [step] for steps, [ok]/[fail] for results with 8-space indent.
issues.fix_suggestion: Replace '[test]' with '[step]', use 'echo "        [ok] go version"' and 'echo "        [fail] go version failed"' with 8-space indent.

issues.description: Redundant 'import subprocess' inside build() method — subprocess is already imported at module level (line 11). This is dead code that may cause confusion.
issues.fix_suggestion: Remove the inline 'import subprocess' statement from the build() method.

issues.description: Multiple inline imports inside functions instead of at module level: 'import tarfile, tempfile, shutil' in source() (line 110), 'import tarfile' in build() (line 158), 'import time' in sign_elf() (line 55). Code-style rule #16 expects imports at the top of the file in proper order (stdlib → third-party → project).
issues.fix_suggestion: Move 'import tarfile', 'import tempfile', 'import time' to the top-level stdlib import section alongside 'import os, import shutil, import subprocess'. Note: 'shutil' is already imported at top level — remove the duplicate inline import.

issues.description: Notes mention 'src/cmd/dist/buildtool.go' as modified, but no patch exists for this file. Only 'src/cmd/dist/build.go' is patched (patch 0002). This is a documentation inaccuracy.
issues.fix_suggestion: Correct the notes to only mention 'src/cmd/dist/build.go', or create and include a patch for buildtool.go if modifications were actually made to it.

issues.description: Conan-generated environment deactivation script committed to the repository. This file is auto-generated by Conan's VirtualRunEnv generator during test execution and should not be version-controlled. It also contains a very long PATH with repeated segments.
issues.fix_suggestion: Add 'test_package/deactivate_conanrunenv*' to .gitignore and remove this file from the PR. It will be regenerated automatically during test runs.

issues.description: Test only checks 'go version' and 'go env' — while this verifies the binary exists and runs, a more thorough smoke test would compile a 'Hello World' program end-to-end to verify the full compiler toolchain works. notes.md mentions Hello World was tested manually but not in test_package.
issues.fix_suggestion: Add a test case that creates a simple hello.go file, compiles it with 'go build hello.go', and runs the resulting binary to verify the compiler produces working executables.

issues.description: patch_generation section contains developer-specific absolute paths (/storage/Users/currentUser/tmp/builds/go-1.21.13.orig and .work). These are local build environment paths that leak developer-specific information and won't be valid on other machines.
issues.fix_suggestion: Remove or sanitize local paths in the patch_generation section, or exclude this metadata section from the published manifest.

issues.description: Extra 'patch_source' field not defined in code-style spec for conandata.yml. The spec (rule #13) only defines patch_file, patch_description, and patch_type fields for patch entries.
issues.fix_suggestion: Either remove the 'patch_source' field to conform to the spec, or document it as an accepted schema extension in the code-style rules.

summary: W4 Pre-PR Audit (re-run) for go/1.21.13 — VERDICT: PASS. All 3 previously identified P1 issues have been correctly fixed and verified: (1) cpp_info.bindirs now uses relative path ['bin'] via bin_dir variable ✓, (2) notes.md status is 'built' matching manifest.yaml status 'built' ✓, (3) unused 'import stat' has been removed ✓. P0 deception detection: No issues found — sha256 values are valid 64-char hex (not all-zeros/f); test_package runs real Go commands (go version, go env GOROOT, go env GOVERSION) not empty stubs; status 'built' is honest (verified but not uploaded); no pre-compiled binaries in PR; patches contain substantive ELF signing logic not empty stubs. P1 recipe correctness: No issues remain — version 1.21.13 is upstream (first adaptation); source URL is official go.dev; commands.json exists with type='tool'; Conan 2.x API used; cpp_info.bindirs is relative ['bin']; notes.md/manifest.yaml status consistent. 5 P2 code-style issues found (missing shebangs in both conanfile.py files, template placeholder url='', missing pipefail, non-standard output markers). 7 P3 suggestions for improvement (redundant/inline imports, documentation inaccuracy, generated file committed, test depth, local paths in manifest, extra conandata field). No P0/P1 issues blocking merge.
